title: IoT Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build from electronics, programming and networking into connected devices, sensors, embedded systems, IoT protocols, cloud platforms, edge computing and secure IoT deployments.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. from 2026–2030. If an honours/research pathway is available, use the additional depth for embedded systems, IoT security, edge AI, distributed systems, industrial IoT or research.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build electronics, programming, networking, embedded and IoT application fundamentals through connected-device projects.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in IoT platforms, embedded IoT, industrial IoT, IoT cloud, edge computing or IoT security.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward senior IoT, edge, systems or IoT architecture responsibilities.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine IoT with edge AI, 5G/6G, digital twins, cybersecurity, cloud-native systems and autonomous devices.

rows.text: C/C++, Python, digital electronics and basic circuits

Embedded C, UART, SPI, I2C, CAN and device debugging
TCP/IP, MQTT, HTTP, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and networking

Edge computing, security, OTA updates and device management
